Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui

Interface UserFileAccessService

All Known Implementing Classes:
UserFileAccessService.Unavailable
public interface UserFileAccessService
Mediated access to files outside plugin storage, granted only by an explicit user choice.

A plugin never names a path: it submits a UserFileRequest, the runtime shows the chooser, and a granted UserFileHandle is the only capability that the read and write methods accept. Every operation is asynchronous and reports failure as an error value in the result rather than as an exception, so a denied, expired, revoked, or foreign handle surfaces as a UserFileError rather than a throw.

    • readBytes

      CompletionStage<UserFileReadResult<byte[]>> readBytes(UserFileHandle handle, int maxBytes)
      Reads at most maxBytes bytes, with a maximum request of 16 MiB. A larger file returns a bounded value with truncated=true; a request above this limit returns UserFileErrorCode.SIZE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

    • readBytesBounded

      default CompletionStage<UserFileReadResult<byte[]>> readBytesBounded(UserFileHandle handle, int maxBytes)
      Reads at most maxBytes bytes from the handle's file, with a maximum request limit of 128 MiB (134,217,728 bytes).

      A larger file returns a bounded value with truncated=true; a request above this 128 MiB limit returns UserFileErrorCode.SIZE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

      The default implementation provides backward compatibility: requests up to 16 MiB delegate to readBytes(UserFileHandle, int), while requests above 16 MiB complete with a structured unsupported error (UserFileErrorCode.RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE). Runtimes supporting higher limits override this method.

      Parameters:
      handle - the granted user-file handle
      maxBytes - the maximum number of bytes to read, up to 134,217,728 (128 MiB)
      Returns:
      a completion stage with the read result or structured error
